# FlowBoard

> FlowBoard is a simple Kanban board for tracking work from backlog to done.

## What it does
- Create cards with a title, assignee, priority (High, Medium, Low, None) and due date
- Organize cards in four columns: Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done
- Drag cards between columns, or move them with the keyboard (Alt + arrow keys)
- Each person sees only their own cards

## Access
FlowBoard requires an account (email and password). The board is private; the sign-in page is the only public page.
